text: Every ID-bearing location shall be rewritten/tracked, including helper specializations, callable signatures, statically materialized packets/descriptors, object root types, function refs, and lifecycle records. No provisional numeric ID shall be embedded untracked; profile-fixed constants shall be the explicit exception. Layout/ABI fingerprints shall be validated before byte writes.
